messages.content: The flag failed: node has no --nope-flag option (exit 9, "node: bad option: --nope-flag"). Node rejects unknown double-dash options with exit code 9 before running any script; to inspect available flags use `node --help` or `node --v8-options`, and to verify the binary works use `node --version` (prints v22.x).

steps.label: Diagnosis: unknown node CLI option → hard exit 9 before script load; correct check is node --help / node --version
